Sprint Retro Ideas

Run better sprint retrospectives — pick a format (Start/Stop/Continue, 4Ls, Sailboat, Mad/Sad/Glad, Starfish) and get guided question prompts.

Tip: timebox each column to 10 minutes and end with 1–3 concrete action items.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a retro format.
  2. Read through the guided prompts.
  3. Copy them into your retro board.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which retro formats are included?

Start/Stop/Continue, the 4Ls (Liked, Learned, Lacked, Longed for), Sailboat, Mad/Sad/Glad, and Starfish — each with its own prompt set.

What do I get per format?

Each format ships with 4–6 facilitator questions you can read out or paste into your retro board.

Can I copy the prompts?

Yes — copy the whole prompt set with one click.
